signals.label: Hidden caps
signals.finding: The deal says "unlimited", but the vendor's own pages meter usage.

evidence.quote: With 80 servers around the world, it’s easy to change your location and IP address on unlimited devices at the same time
Users, who use more than 1% of the entire bandwidth of the GOOSE network, will be approached by GOOSE to reduce the use, or to make a higher payment.
GOOSE does not apply a strict bandwidth limitation in its most extensive subscription. However, a fair use policy does apply.

signals.label: Support complaints
signals.finding: 4 reviews (2.1% of all) say support is slow or gone.

evidence.quote: Doesn't look like they are replying to any comments on AppSumo anymore
it doesn't seem like they care to have any type of dialog with customers.
So I cannot even contact their support.

signals.label: Review trend
signals.finding: Newest 20 reviews average 2.45/5 vs 3.66/5 all-time (-1.21). 29% of all reviews are 1-2 stars.

signals.label: Tier trap
signals.finding: The cheapest tier is a usable slice of the product.

signals.label: Discount size
signals.finding: $29 vs a stated $149 regular price (81% off).

signals.label: One-sided change clauses
signals.finding: The terms let the vendor change features or pricing at any time.

evidence.quote: GOOSE has the right at any time to adjust these terms and conditions, the privacy statement, and the technical characteristics of the service and rates.

trials.claim: Change location and IP address on unlimited devices at same time with 80 servers
trials.claimQuote: With 80 servers around the world, it’s easy to change your location and IP address on unlimited devices at the same time.
trials.reasoning: The vendor page shows capped 1- and 5-device choices, limiting the claim of unlimited devices at the same time. A buyer also reports fewer than 25 countries available, undercutting the claimed worldwide breadth of 80 servers.

exhibits.quote:
5 device of your choice

-

1 device of your choice
exhibits.argument: The lifetime deal sells capped 1, 5 and 10 device tiers, which contradicts changing IP on unlimited devices at the same time.

exhibits.quote: Less than 25 countries available, out of which only TWO are in Asia (Japan & Singapore)
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports far fewer locations than implied, undermining the 80 servers around the world breadth claim.

exhibits.quote: A VPN changes your location and IP address. This keeps you from being tracked by advertisers and malicious parties.
exhibits.argument: Vendor states the VPN changes location and IP address as claimed.

exhibits.quote: Option of unlimited number of devices per account.
exhibits.argument: Vendor confirms unlimited number of devices per account.

trials.claim: Protects vulnerable data with secure VPN and keeps browsing private
trials.claimQuote: Protect your vulnerable data with a secure VPN and keep your browsing private
trials.reasoning: Two buyers report IP and DNS leaks, which directly defeat private, protected browsing. These leak reports materially undercut the vendor's general secure-VPN marketing.

exhibits.quote: just discovered my IP is leaking like a busted pipe, which defeats the entire purpose of having a VPN in the first place.
exhibits.argument: A reported IP leak directly contradicts protection of vulnerable data and keeping browsing private.

exhibits.quote: Dutch servers are frequently unavailable, have DNS leaks, and I can't get the IKEv2 protocol to work on any device, old or new.
exhibits.argument: Reported DNS leaks and unavailable servers undermine the claim of private secure browsing.

exhibits.quote: GOOSE VPN is a secure VPN service that lets you browse the internet anonymously while protecting your data.
exhibits.argument: Vendor describes a secure VPN service that protects data and enables anonymous browsing.

exhibits.quote: That’s why you need a secure VPN service that protects your data, while also letting you access geo-restricted content.
exhibits.argument: Vendor states users need a secure VPN service that protects data.

trials.claim: Secure VPN service protects sensitive data and keeps browsing private
trials.claimQuote: GOOSE VPN is a secure VPN service that protects your sensitive data and keeps your browsing private.
trials.reasoning: The vendor directly states it is a secure VPN that protects data, browses anonymously, and keeps data private. The prosecution exhibits about flagged or blacklisted IPs causing blocks do not show data exposure or loss of privacy.

exhibits.quote: The service frequently connects me to IP addresses that are flagged for malicious activity, which causes issues like being blocked by Google.
exhibits.argument: Flagged malicious IPs being blocked contradicts protecting sensitive data and keeping browsing private.

exhibits.quote: often the IP addresses are marked by isps and some websites as black listed which means we can use those services while using goose vpn or until goose vpn changes their ip addresses through which they route traffic.
exhibits.argument: Blacklisted IPs reported by buyers undermine reliable private browsing.

exhibits.quote: GOOSE VPN is a secure VPN service that lets you browse the internet anonymously while protecting your data.
exhibits.argument: Vendor uses the same secure service language and promises anonymous browsing with data protection.

exhibits.quote: Work and surf securely anywhere in the world with GOOSE VPN. Your data always remains private, as it belongs to you alone.
exhibits.argument: Vendor promises secure surfing with data remaining private.

trials.claim: Guarantees secure connection to stay safe from hackers
trials.claimQuote: GOOSE VPN guarantees that you’ll have a secure connection, so you can stay safe from hackers.
trials.reasoning: The binding terms expressly say GOOSE cannot guarantee this due to breakdowns and maintenance, contradicting a guaranteed secure connection. A buyer also reports frequent failure to connect or stay connected.

exhibits.quote: However, GOOSE cannot guarantee this due to inter alia breakdowns, necessary maintenance and adjustments of the system for improvement.
exhibits.argument: The vendor expressly disclaims any guarantee of security and availability, contradicting the guarantee of a secure connection.

exhibits.quote: Doesn't connect and when it does, it disconnects within 6-secs
exhibits.argument: Failure to stay connected contradicts the guaranteed secure connection to stay safe from hackers.

exhibits.quote: Once you are connected to a VPN server, no one can watch you, including hackers, governments or your internet provider.
exhibits.argument: Vendor guarantees protection from hackers once connected to a VPN server.

exhibits.quote: Using military-grade encryption, we’re able to protect your online privacy and internet security.
exhibits.argument: Vendor claims military-grade encryption protects privacy and security for a secure connection.
